description: This file defines classes and structures related to front panel indicator management within a device settings namespace. It includes class declarations, constants, and methods to handle indicator colors, blinking sequences, brightness, and states, primarily for testing or stub purposes in a software project.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator
classes.description: Represents a front panel indicator device, managing its properties such as brightness, color, blink sequences, and state. It extends DSConstant and is designed as a singleton with static getter methods.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Color
classes.description: Defines pre-set color constants for the indicator and provides a singleton accessor for color instances.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Blink
classes.description: Encapsulates blink sequence parameters such as interval and iteration count for the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for FrontPanelIndicator instances by id.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for FrontPanelIndicator instances by name.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Color::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a color based on an integer id.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Color::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a color based on a string name.

methods.name: Blink::getInterval
methods.description: Returns the blink interval value.

methods.name: Blink::getIteration
methods.description: Returns the number of blink iterations.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level of the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getBrightnessLevels
methods.description: Gets the brightness levels, minimum and maximum levels supported.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getColorMode
methods.description: Returns the current color mode (single or multi-color).

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getBlink
methods.description: Returns the current blink configuration for the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getMaxCycleRate
methods.description: Returns the maximum cycle rate for LED scrolling.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::setBlink
methods.description: Sets the blink sequence parameters.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getColor
methods.description: Returns the current color ID as a uint32.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::setColor
methods.description: Sets the indicator color using a Color object or a raw RGB value.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::setState
methods.description: Enables or disables the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getState
methods.description: Returns whether the indicator is enabled.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getSupportedColors
methods.description: Retrieves supported color options.
